scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @pointer/contracts typecheck && pnpm --filter @pointer/server typecheck && pnpm --filter @pointer/cli typecheck && pnpm --filter @pointer/web typecheck
scripts.test:unit: pnpm --filter @pointer/server test && pnpm --filter @pointer/cli test && bun test scripts/*.test.mjs
scripts.verify: pnpm public-source:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm contracts:check && pnpm deployment:check && pnpm build:server && pnpm test:unit && pnpm build:web
scripts.verify:full: pnpm verify && pnpm test:postgres && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm artifact:server && pnpm artifact:web && pnpm artifact:verify
